# Codeyoung

> Codeyoung offers online coding and STEM education classes for kids, combining creative learning with hands-on activities in programming, science, and problem-solving.

Codeyoung specializes in making technology and science accessible to young learners through interactive courses in coding, AI/ML, and science. The platform emphasizes creative expression, productive screen time, and skill-building through engaging tutorials and educational content.

## Key Topics

- Coding for Kids
- STEM Education
- Scratch Programming
- Python & AI/ML
- Science Classes
- Hands-On Learning
- Game Development
- Problem-Solving Skills
- Creative Coding
- Online Courses
- Math Education
- Early Reading Skills
- Educational Resources
- Kids Education

## Core Courses

- [AI and Machine Learning with Python](https://www.codeyoung.com/coding/python-ai-ml): AI and machine learning with Python online classes for kids
- [Online Science Classes](https://www.codeyoung.com/science): Online science classes for kids with hands-on experiments

## Coding Tutorials & Guides

- [How to Make a Game on Scratch Step-by-Step for Beginners](https://www.codeyoung.com/blog/how-to-make-a-game-on-scratch): Beginner-friendly Scratch tutorial for game creation and design
- [How to Make a Maze in Scratch in 7 Steps](https://www.codeyoung.com/blog/how-to-make-a-maze-in-scratch-in-7-steps-cm9mm1od700ct14n5eix7ot9b): Step-by-step Scratch tutorial for creating maze games for kids
- [45 Best Coding Games for Kids in 2024](https://www.codeyoung.com/blog/45-best-coding-games-for-kids-in-2024-clwscc50e003mr5g3i5517n5d): Comprehensive list of 45 coding games for kids learning programming
